title: 2026 Year-End Wealth Planning Review
summary: We have published our 2026 Year-End Wealth Planning Review, highlighting recent tax changes and other planning developments to consider as year-end approaches.
body_markdown:
We have published our 2026 Year-End Wealth Planning Review, highlighting recent tax changes and other planning developments to consider as year-end approaches.


New charitable and itemized deduction limitations, higher State and Local Tax (SALT) deductions, estate and gift tax exemptions and retirement contributions, and the redesigned Qualified Opportunity Zone (QOZ) framework, are among the topics covered.


Please contact[\[email protected\]](https://evercorewealthandtrust.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#d8afbdb9b4acb0b5b9b6b9bfbdb5bdb6ac98bdaebdaabbb7aabdf6bbb7b5) to receive a copy.
